text:
laura: Quick topic poll — proposing webinar: "Serving LLMs: predictable latency across regions". Aim 30–40min with demo. Need: 2 short abstracts (<=600 chars) by Fri, 3 speakers (PM, infra, customer), rehearsal Wed. Thoughts?

anya: Love it. Emphasize routing & graceful degradation. I can draft an abstract + speaker notes. :thumbsup:

tom: I can be infra speaker. Demo idea: failover from Dedicated -> Hosted. Wed 10:00 works for rehearsal for me.

rachel: I'll own speaker invites + slide collection. Suggest run-of-show: 35m total — 8m intro, 12m demo, 8m deep dive, 7m Q&A.

laura: Add a pre-recorded 90s micro-demo as a fallback if live demo fails. @tom can you produce a recording?

studio-bot: Rehearsal slot booked: Wed 10:00–11:00, Studio C. Calendar invites sent.

tom: Noted. Demo fallback plan: run against small load generator. Quick command to test locally:
```
bash run_demo --model redwood-rt --region us-west --failover true
```

anya: Draft abstracts (very short):
1) "Unified runtime for predictable inference" — how smart routing + caching keep latency steady across regions.
2) "Cost-aware routing: balance latency and spend" — heuristics we use to route traffic under constraints.

rachel: Speaker roster: PM: @laura, Infra: @tom, Customer: @jess (invited, accepted). I'll follow up on bios.

laura: Run-of-show draft (timings):
```
00:00 intro & product thesis (laura)
05:00 customer story (jess)
10:00 live demo + failover (tom)
22:00 routing & cost deep dive (anya)
30:00 open Q&A
35:00 closing
```

rachel: Added assets due dates: abstracts by Tue EOD, slides by Wed 12:00. Who moderates live chat?

tom: I can monitor live chat / flag infra questions.

anya: Recommend a 5–minute slide handoff script between speakers so transitions stay tight.

laura: Final asks: drop abstract drafts here by EOD Tue, upload slides to the shared drive by Wed noon, and confirm any prerecorded clips. :calendar: Thanks!
